description:
You are assisting a capacity planner in analyzing server resource usage. There is a CSV file located at /home/user/server_resources.csv with the columns server_id, cpu_usage, and memory_usage. Your task is to create a JSON summary report at /home/user/resource_summary.json using the data in the CSV file. The summary report must contain the following information:
  • For each server_id, include an object with the average cpu_usage and average memory_usage.
  • The JSON file must be a dictionary mapping each server_id to a summary object with keys avg_cpu_usage and avg_memory_usage.
  • All numeric values should be rounded to two decimal places.
  • The resource summary file must be formatted with 2-space indents.
For example, the final /home/user/resource_summary.json should look precisely like this: 
{
  "svr01": {
    "avg_cpu_usage": 78.25,
    "avg_memory_usage": 4096.67
  },
  "svr02": {
    "avg_cpu_usage": 65.00,
    "avg_memory_usage": 2048.35
  }
}
Your summary must include all server_id values present in the CSV file. When you have finished, verify your output matches the format described above.
